consequence.statement: Environments that use non-AL2023 AMIs get updated AMIFamily handling after upgrading to 1.0.0, so node provisioning from those AMIs should be verified.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading to 1.0.0, verify that nodes launched from non-AL2023 AMIs are still provisioned as intended.

original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 updates AMIFamily for non-AL2023 AMIs (bugfix #6638), so environments that use non-AL2023 AMIs will see changed AMIFamily handling after upgrading.

consequence.statement: The change touches only E2E test environment and drift test suite files, not shipped controller code or APIs. An environment that does nothing sees no change in behaviour.

corrected.statement: PR #6638 (Update AMIFamily for non-AL2023 AMIs) changes only Karpenter's E2E test code (test/pkg/environment/aws/environment.go, test/suites/drift/suite_test.go). Operators see no operational consequence in 1.0.0.

decision.reason: The release note [ev-e21588eef5b6] and the PR description [ev-8d60e1cd9157] only say "Update AMIFamily for non-AL2023 versions". The PR and commit change only two files, test/pkg/environment/aws/environment.go and test/suites/drift/suite_test.go [ev-b10097ad63d2][ev-af1646dba20c], which is E2E test code. Shipped Karpenter behaviour does not change, so a behavior-change review over-claims, and the consequence should be none (informational).
